page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Centred block of title lines at the top, a large engraved device (emblem) in the middle, and a short imprint line at the bottom. No margins with text. The scan shows some mirrored show-through from the reverse, which is left out.
page.notes: The title lines are very faint and partly mirrored by show-through, so most words are doubtful; the readings marked [?] are best guesses. The large central engraving is an ornamented device with a sun or star-like motif in a frame, with no text. The imprint at the foot is barely legible. The printed page number and running head are absent.
